summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Homeland Security to submit to Congress within 180 days a detailed plan for identifying, integrating, and deploying emerging technologies like AI, machine learning, and advanced sensors to improve border security operations, while authorizing CBP Innovation Teams to research and adapt such technologies and mandating annual reports on their activities.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses entirely on improving border security operations through the identification and deployment of emerging technologies. This directly aligns with the 'Secure Borders' aspect of the immigration topic.
